name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1887: Two gaps closed. Mixed panels in one reel now drive the sweep - stash then runes then inventory inside one recording, each item landing in the lane of the panel it was seen on, the same item on two panels staying two rows, and a gameplay panel between them costing nothing. And the board vault apply was driven in a real page under headless Chrome because it lives inside a closure no unit test can reach: all four rules it states about itself hold, five hundred tally items land in 242 milliseconds, and a throw-out naming something he owns leaves it owned. The one finding is that a count of zero was reported as no readable count, which attaches a wrong reason to a right action.
